title: Coverage Space Definition
description:
The cross-scenario read contract for a coverage-space *denominator*. Each projection owner (search-hub=Answer, test-genie=Validate, prompt-manager=Guide) emits its curated space doc as schema-valid JSON via the `space --projection

--json` verb. This is the DENOMINATOR only — the curated intended space; the numerator (live actual coverage) is NEVER carried here, it is joined live by meta-optimization-manager. The canonical model lives in scenarios/meta-optimization-manager/docs/concepts/COVERAGE-MODEL.md.

schema_version.description: Schema contract version. Bump on a breaking change to this shape.

projection.description: Which of the three readiness projections this denominator covers.

owner.description: The scenario that owns this denominator (holds its ground truth).

denominator_confidence.description: How complete we believe the denominator itself is. Recursive honesty: coverage is always 'X% against a Y-confidence denominator'.

confidence_rationale.description: Prose justification for the denominator_confidence verdict (verbatim from the space doc).

source.description: Provenance: the space-doc path this JSON was parsed from.

cells.description: The denominator grid rows. Sparse: nonsensical entity x archetype combinations are omitted.

id.description: Stable cell identifier, unique within the projection (e.g. '23', 'V1', 'G1').

group.description: The grid section the cell came from (granularity tier or category, e.g. 'G0 - Project', 'Understand').

question.description: The question / concern / SWE-task the cell denotes.

owner.description: The provider / phase / skill that should answer it (the per-cell owner).

status.description: Live status, normalized across projections: NOW/COVERED -> now, IN-REACH/PARTIAL -> in_reach, MISSING -> missing.

basis.description: Best attainable epistemic basis (Answer projection only; omitted elsewhere).

sufficiency.description: Whether the source is shaped to answer the question (optional).

notes.description: Qualitative context / gap-registry notes / explored approaches for this cell.
